research_question: How should mid-market manufacturers set an evidence bar for third-party Scope-3 emissions factors before using them in customer RFQ sustainability questionnaires through 2027?
audience: Manufacturing sustainability lead and commercial RFQ owners.
scope: Synthetic source pack only; cover evidence tiers vs vendor claims, failure modes, counter-evidence, disclosure stance and kill criteria through 2027. No live web.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): evidence bar, failure modes, counter-evidence, disclosure/kill criteria. Registries and checklist separate.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; do not promote vendor factor packs as audit-ready; disclose no independent review.
